description: This file defines deprecation support structures and functions for the Ginkgo testing framework, including deprecation messages, tracking, and reporting mechanisms.

classes.name: Deprecation
classes.description: Represents a deprecation message, documentation link, and version.

classes.name: deprecations
classes.description: Provides methods to generate specific deprecation messages.

classes.name: DeprecationTracker
classes.description: Tracks deprecations and their code locations, and generates reports.

classes.name: SemVer
classes.description: Semantic versioning structure with comparison methods.

methods.name: CustomReporter
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the removal of custom reporters in Ginkgo V2.

methods.name: Async
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about deprecated asynchronous test behavior.

methods.name: Measure
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the removal of Measure tests.

methods.name: ParallelNode
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the deprecation of GinkgoParallelNode.

methods.name: CurrentGinkgoTestDescription
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the deprecation of CurrentGinkgoTestDescription.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the deprecation of the convert command.

methods.name: Blur
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the deprecation of the blur command.

methods.name: Nodot
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the deprecation of the nodot command.

methods.name: SuppressProgressReporting
methods.description: Returns a Deprecation message about the deprecation of progress reporting suppression.

methods.name: NewDeprecationTracker
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeprecationTracker.

methods.name: TrackDeprecation
methods.description: Tracks a deprecation occurrence with optional code location.

methods.name: DidTrackDeprecations
methods.description: Checks if any deprecations have been tracked.

methods.name: DeprecationsReport
methods.description: Generates a report of all tracked deprecations.

methods.name: GreaterThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Compares two SemVer instances for version precedence.

methods.name: ParseSemVer
methods.description: Parses a semantic version string into a SemVer struct.
